title: The Three Emperors' League of 1881 is an agreement among three empires
summary: Avalon prints the Three Emperors' League of 18 June 1881 as its own agreement.
body: Avalon prints the Three Emperors' League of 18 June 1881. It is a diplomatic agreement among the empires, distinct from the 1879 Dual Alliance of only two of them. The wording on the page includes: "1700 - 1799 19th Century 1800 - 1899 20th Century 1900 - 1999 21st Century 2000 - The Three Emperors League - June 18, 1881 Art 1 Art 2 Art 3 Art 4 Art 5 Art 6 The Courts of Austria-Hungary, of Germany, and of Russia, animated by an equal desire to consolidate the general peace by an understanding intended to assure the defensive position of their respective".
said_by: Avalon Project text of the league
